title: Trend Chaser: A Checkpointed AI-Assisted Workflow for Printful-to-Shopify Merchandise Releases
description:
Trend Chaser is a portable, human-authorized workflow for taking a supplied idea or graphic through artwork preparation, print preflight, Printful configuration, Shopify publication and storefront verification.

The package includes execution instructions, operator configuration and release-record templates, provider recovery notes, a synthetic pending-publication example, and validation limits. It preserves asset lineage, scopes publication approval, checkpoints progress and reconciles uncertain writes before retrying.

This release documents an assistant-orchestrated process. It requires an active assistant session, authenticated accounts and suitable connected tools. It does not contain a standalone API, background trend monitor, credentials, merchandise artwork or private operational history. Validation derives from one completed owner-operated release and an offline recovery exercise; physical fulfillment and cross-account portability have not been tested.
